collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: A navigator wonders whether distant peoples travel over land in vessels pulled by animals - or moved by some unknown force.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A navigator wonders whether distant peoples travel over land in vessels pulled by animals - or moved by some unknown force.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Children design wheeled carts that race faster than a running villager, at least in their drawings.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The builders discover that speed creates problems of steering, stopping, and safe crossings.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The council imagines a shared vehicle carrying strangers to common destinations.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A parent asks how a tired child or disabled traveler would board; the plan is revised.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A farmer says even distant cities may contain people who prefer to walk.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A traveler notes that long distances might make walking impossible for some; they debate equitable access.
